newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean natgas project secures $450 mln in loans.
newsitem.headline: Chilean natgas project secures $450 mln in loans.

text.p: GasAtacama, a natural gas pipeline project of Chilean utility Endesa and CMS Energy, has secured $450 million in financing for its plan to transport Argentine gas to northern Chile, the daily El Mercurio reported on Tuesday.
El Mercurio said Chase Manhattan and CS First Boston would organize the loans, which would finance nearly two-thirds of the 925-km (575-mile) project's $650 million estimated cost.
Endesa general manager Jaime Bauza, quoted in the newspaper, said GasAtacama would be northern Chile's most attractive and profitable energy venture.

Bauza added that GasAtacama was in talks with another consortium led by Chilean utility Electroandina SA that was planning to build its own natgas pipeline. However, he stressed that the parties were only in talks thus far, not negotiations.
